citation: A business's premises are assessed at about 0.4 of a year's sales: the net stock of private nonresidential structures (BEA Fixed Assets, about 17 trillion dollars in 2022) over private industries' gross output (BEA, about 40 trillion dollars in 2022); figures from the published tables as remembered, not fetched this session.
